terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: Lashed bamboo, nothing hinged and nothing attaching: one root pivot, zero sockets. A riverside sala or beach-mat table sat at from the floor, placed in twos and threes, so the two draw calls are the design constraint. Riversides, beach mats, rural salas; honey-tan slats with grain and a knot, grey-blue culms flaking to pale patches, cream twine at every joint, sat at from the floor.

reasoning: TWO components on TWO materials: the TIMBER top (seven slat boxes, two rails, four stretchers and a knot merged) and the CULM posts (four posts, four node rings, eight twine bands and the twine bow merged). Two draw calls of two.

Two materials because the honey sawn slats (0.72, a sawn-grain canvas) and the weathered grey-blue culms (0.60, a culm canvas with node rings) share neither tone nor texture; both WHITE with the tones as vertex colours.
No repetition system: seven slats are seven boxes inside the top merge.
Action readiness: one root pivot, zero sockets, one declared box collider, not breakable.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The identity is seven THICK slats with visible gaps between four fat weathered culms that stand proud of the top, lashed with cream twine, over a low stretcher ring. Twenty thin battens or posts flush with the top would be a different table; the gaps and the proud culms are what the plate shows.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 0.57 x 0.42 x 0.47 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=2000 triangles, <=2 draw calls, <=2 materials, <=4 unique geometries.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A marker named for a place on the surface is a location, not a mechanism.

actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group fails the gate just as a missing one would.

silhouette.description: Seven 0.049 x 0.042 slats at 0.058 pitch topping at 0.395 between four r 0.029 culms on +-0.245 x +-0.18 rising to 0.42, on two r 0.020 rails at 0.336 and a ring of r 0.018 stretchers at 0.105-0.135, twine bands at both.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x +-0.278 at the culm skins, y 0 to 0.420 at the culm tops, z +-0.213 at the culms. The LIST-TIME declaration was 0.90 x 0.42 x 0.60 (w/h 2.14, d/h 1.43). The Meshy proxy of the plate measures bbox 1.889 x 1.399 x 1.555, w/h 1.351 and d/h 1.112. The plate is a steep top-down view that hides the height, and the declared 0.42 is the identity (a LOW table), so height is kept and the plan follows the proxy: 0.42 x 1.351 = 0.567 -> 0.57 m by 0.42 x 1.112 = 0.467 -> 0.47 m; the declaration was corrected before building. The materials agree: on a 0.57 m top the plate's slats (74 px pitch of a 750 px width) are 0.056 m and its 60 px posts 0.046 m -- split bamboo and a culm -- where at 0.90 m they would be 0.09 and 0.07. Stations off the proxy (occupancy, 50 rows of H, 80 columns of W): posts at columns 5-13 and 66-74 (centres +-0.433 W = +-0.245) from row 0.00 to 0.98, the culms rising past the slat top; slat top faces at row 0.94 with slat SIDE faces as seven vertical columns over rows 0.86-0.92 (0.042 m thick -- few and thick); side rails at rows 0.78-0.84 under the slats; a stretcher ring at rows 0.20-0.30; post z range 0.90 D, so post centres at z +-0.18.
silhouette.meshyCrossCheck: Independent Meshy v7 reconstruction of the same plate: bbox 1.889 x 1.399 x 1.555, w/h 1.351 and d/h 1.112, which corrected the declared 0.90 x 0.60 plan to 0.57 x 0.47. Its slat pitch reads 0.074 because the 20 mm voxel fuses each slat with its gap; the plate's 74 px of 750 (0.056) is used instead.

viewEvidence.note: NOT OBSERVED. The plate looks down on the top; the rails, the stretcher ring height and the post length are the proxy's (rows 0.78-0.84 and 0.20-0.30), confidence 0.7.

actionProfile.notes: Rigidly parented to the root. NO pivot and NO socket, deliberately: this part does not move and nothing attaches to it.

roughness.notes: Scalar observed for this surface in the plate. The independently extracted map is kept on disk as evidence and is NOT bound at runtime -- this material is textureless, so the scalar is the runtime value.

albedo.samplingNotes: Measured as the mean of crops/slats.png. extract_pbr_evidence confidence 0.835. The extractor palette is advisory only: these crops are flat material swatches, not isolated objects, so its foreground separation is weak by its own warnings. Albedo is the direct crop measurement.

localOverrides.region: the fourth slat, and grain across all seven
localOverrides.evidence: crops/slats.png -- a dark knot on the fourth slat and longitudinal grain on every slat; the knot is a proud disc, the grain the sawn canvas.

evidence: Measured on the plate: slats #eec093 / #e9b179 (187-201) with a shaded slat at #bea288 (167) and a knot; analyze_texture meanLum 175 sat 0.45 mottle 0.10; extract_pbr_evidence palette #E8B98C #E0A974 #F2CAA0 #6E3F1E #B38157 at confidence 0.835.

Textureless as DECLARED: slats 0xd9a86e and poles 0xc4945e as vertex colours (slats probed 202-205 on beauty-000 against the plate's 187-201) under a 512 px sawn-grain canvas at 0.30 m through world UVs; the knot a darker disc 0.5 mm proud.
textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely -- FIVE canvases per material written pixel by pixel, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: with a texture set the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo.

buildPasses.goal: Match material color, roughness, bump, and local variation.
acceptance: Reference-derived albedo palette records dominant, secondary, and accent colors per visible material.
Each important material defines roughness variation and at least one normal/bump/displacement response.
Local material overrides, dirt/wear/stains/moss/chips/scratches or equivalent masks are tied to evidenceRefs.
Thin, transparent, reflective, wet, or fibrous materials document alpha/transmission/clearcoat/metalness/fiber response when relevant.
Generated preview uses procedural albedo/roughness/bump texture or vertex color variation instead of one flat color.
Generated preview uses independent PBR maps at 1024px or higher for the quality-first tier.
If source pixels are available, referencePbr extraction passed at confidence >= 0.7 or the pass is stopped/requesting better references.
Macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands are visible at the intended review distance without obvious tiling.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Add procedural surface locality such as normal/bump/displacement, AO, dirt, stains, chips, grain, moss, scratches, and wear.
acceptance: Every required material feature group has local overrides or surfaceDetail tied to evidenceRefs.
A grazing-angle close-up proves that normal/height detail breaks highlights naturally and does not read as smooth plastic.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make material and form readable under neutral turntable lighting plus optional reference lighting.
acceptance: lightingFromPhoto identifies key light direction/color/intensity, fill light, rim or environment light, and ambient color.
Exposure, tone mapping, background color/gradient, shadow softness, and contact shadow behavior are specified.
Lighting does not hide geometry/material gaps and screenshots can be compared fairly to the reference.
Neutral, grazing, and reference-matched lighting checks distinguish material errors from lighting errors.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Make the model ready for future animation, transformation, physics, or destruction.
acceptance: Macro and movable meso components have stable pivot nodes.
Sockets, collider proxies, and destruction metadata are present for future runtime actions.
AI vision comparison score meets selfCorrectLoop.visualAcceptance.threshold.

buildPasses.goal: Protect runtime performance after visual fidelity is accepted.
acceptance: Triangle count, draw calls, instancing, LOD strategy, and FPS target are documented or verified.
Repeated detail is instanced or simplified where possible without breaking silhouette/material believability.

reviewHistory.summary: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.88. 1136/2000 triangles, 2/2 draw calls, 2/2 materials, 2/4 unique geometries, two canvases. Turntable with --allow-holes: the enclosed background is the six slat gaps and the space under the top, real openings.

lodPlan.strategy: full component tree and material layers
merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the medium class and none was invented. The component split was costed against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: parts that share a material are merged into one component rather than left to be merged later, because a pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards.

materials.note: timber and culm: 2 of 2; every tone within each is a vertex colour.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component plus one per repetition system. A scaled box is NOT a shared geometry -- the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh reuses a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point.

triangles.note: 1136 of 2000: seven boxes, seven 10-segment cylinders, sixteen 12-segment cylinders, an 8-segment disc and a box.

lightingFromPhoto.notes: The plate is a flat studio lightbox: surfaces at 90 degrees to each other measure within a few levels, which is only possible under near-shadowless illumination. That is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with little correction.
High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value.

The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. The thaikit harness supplies NO environment map, which is why every metal on this prop carries a metalness well below its physical value -- a metal with nothing to reflect renders black.
NO rim light in the plate. Recorded so a missing rim in the render is not read as a defect.
Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping; no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos and none is warranted.

NO contact or ground shadow in the plate -- it is a cut-out against a seamless backdrop. Recorded so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE this is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: castShadow ships enabled on every mesh and the factory defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: Boxes for the slats and bow; cylinders for rails, stretchers, posts, node rings and twine bands.
No InstancedMesh at two draw calls. In a scene the HOST instances the table.
All procedural variation is assigned by instance INDEX, never from a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.
Both materials are declared textureless. Two 512 px canvases after construction -- sawn grain on the timber, culm rings and streaks on the culm -- 2 MB; the factory built in under 100 ms.
